selected_evidence.requirement: Restore imported tickets with original IDs and text
selected_evidence.summary: The final table contains exactly IDs 1, 2, and 100 with subjects Printer queue, Scanner cable, and Office move.
The sequence was repaired to 100; implicit inserts received IDs 101 and, after reboot, 102. The verification records were not retained, leaving only imported data.
tickets.sql remains at /srv/legacy2/postgresql-sequence-repair with unchanged size and SHA-256 5a9b51de0c539f9ffedd0ca1424be6549bbef62a5414b6545d879d9c1be973c5.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 remained unchanged.

Healthy baseline boot ID a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, the post-restart boot ID changed to 44dc74c0-d2b8-48e0-933b-3fa03db90240, and PostgreSQL, source export, ticket data, and automatic allocation recovered successfully.
